evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected-build complete generated reader programs, source-to-named-field transfers, concrete reference adapters and independent typed count/list programs. The sequential stored decoder closes every field and physical EOF.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Original coherent formatter/provider/class state, normal matching callbacks and helper effects, stable disjoint buffered storage; the list proof admits fresh or reused-empty lists with sufficient capacity.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Stored render configuration; no runtime selection, GPU addressing, shader consumption or texture identity is asserted.

family.evidenceBoundary: Exact declared exception-table framing and complete parent triples establish selected-primary range membership, including nested and noncontiguous chains. Version 1/2 code-slot contents, fixed-allocation consistency, handlers, managed control flow, live MethodInfo and execution remain separate proofs; adjacency and start-address-only joins are not used.

inlineAdvanceSource.condition: Exact selected actual E8 helper, nonnegative requested count no larger than Reader remaining bytes, nonwrapping disjoint Reader/storage and ordinary Win64 call ABI. Full currentPtr/advancedCount/consumed/bufferLength effects and saved frame are proved; underflow/refill and runtime invocation remain unobserved.
